message.name: NEMYX_CMD_STRIKE
message.field: Bitset. Bit i (0..255) indicates whether agent ID i+1 is targeted. Byte j contains bits for IDs (j*8+1 .. j*8+8), LSB-first.

message.name: NEMYX_TRACKING_STATUS
message.description: Tracking status broadcast by each agent in strike mode.

message.name: LAUNCH_POSITION_REACHED
message.description: Sent by the commercial_drone_dock launch-ctrl once per platform during a launch sequence, the moment the lift physically arrives at that platform's launch position -- strictly before it waits for that platform's drone to report launched.
message.field: Elapsed ms since the move that reached this platform started. Despite the common-dialect name, this is a move DURATION, not a time since boot.
